sources.locator: yield: sheet "Tabl. 22" (ziemniaki), row Wielkopolskie, yields 2021-2025 312, 315, 327, 335, 403 dt/ha, mean 338.4 dt/ha = 33.84 t/ha (our calculation). GUS publishes one yield for all potatoes (table, starch and feed together); there is no separate table-potato yield for Wielkopolskie. Priced yield (D46): the table-potato share of the WODR sheet, 264 of 300 dt (88%), so 33.84 × 0.88 = 29.78 t/ha (our calculation); the feed share (36 dt in the sheet) has no official price and is left out

No official starch-potato price exists for the other pair (WODR's 28,00 PLN/dt is a budget assumption)

sources.title: WODR Poznań, Kalkulacje rolnicze produkcji roślinnej, luty 2026: ziemniaki jadalne (300 dt/ha)
sources.locator: direct costs: page 1, "KOSZTY BEZPOŚREDNIE RAZEM (zł/ha)" 16134,91 PLN/ha (seed potatoes, fertiliser, crop protection, variable costs of own machinery, contracted services, other incl. hired labour). The sheet expects 264 dt of table potatoes and 36 dt of feed potatoes per ha; only the 88% table share is priced (D46). The sheet's own prices (153,63 PLN/dt table, 28,00 PLN/dt feed) give a direct surplus of about 26 100 PLN/ha, so our margin stays below the source. The sheet's "WARTOŚĆ PRODUKCJI" line includes payments and is not used
